title: Identify the account IDs of male clients who opened accounts in 1993, have
question: Identify the account IDs of male clients who opened accounts in 1993, have taken loans with duration over 12 months, and made credit card withdrawals in 1998 with amounts below the 1998 average withdrawal amount.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a."XCL_001"
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON a."XCL_001" = d."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN client AS c ON d."XCL_014" = c."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN card AS cd ON d."XCL_013" = cd."XCL_006"
INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
WHERE c."XCL_010" = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a."XCL_004") = '1993'
  AND l."XCL_037" > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1998'
  AND t."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t."XCL_051" < (SELECT AVG("XCL_051") FROM trans WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', "XCL_048") = '1998')
